scenario: Audit a received shipment against the order
did: Check the delivered unit against the paperwork and decide whether to accept or hold it.
why: Six checks grade the answer against order details — a 5-axis spec, a $2,500 price, a PO number, and approver rules — that aren't in any file the agent was given and it has no way to look up. So a correct "I can't confirm this from what I have" gets marked wrong.
fix: Rework C4–C9 to check only facts the agent can actually see (the packing slip, nameplate photo, and the SOP), not an order of record that isn't provided.
agree: No — I'm stricter; the viewer assumed data the agent was never given

scenario: Read a grocery cereal shelf from photos
did: List every cereal on the shelves with its average price into a spreadsheet.
why: Much improved — most "should-be-absent" decoys are now correct. But two checks still penalize listing Krave and Cocoa Krispies, which are both clearly on the shelves, so a correct reading loses points. One summary check also adds a "retailer promotions" requirement the task never asks for.
fix: Fix the two decoys (C37 Krave, C38 Cocoa Krispies — those cereals are present) and drop the promotions clause from the summary check (C4).
